description:
Based on the erotic game by Lune.

In the kingdom where the elves live, there is a strictly controlled law of race breeding. However, that rule is disrupted by a human man named "Ingwill".
All the elves in the city. Dark Elves, the Queen's knights. Queen of the High Elves who rules the land. The virtuous princess, daughter of the queen.
All of them are made aware of their true nature by "hypnosis"...
